items.name: loobster
items.description: AI-powered development workflow for healthcare software — Research, Propose, Plan, Implement, Test with HIPAA/SOC2/HITRUST compliance gates

items.name: MedGuard
items.description: MedGuard is a robust, production-grade Python library that ensures HIPAA compliance for large language model (LLM) agents. Designed for enterprise applications in healthcare, MedGuard provides comprehensive security, privacy, and compliance frameworks that integrate seamlessly into your AI-driven workflows.

items.name: Prior-Authorization-Multi-Agent-Solution-Accelerator
items.description: Payer-side AI-assisted prior authorization review using Microsoft Agent Framework with four Foundry Hosted Agents (Compliance, Clinical, Coverage, Synthesis). Gate-based decision rubric, MCP healthcare data access, confidence scoring, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop oversight. Deploys via azd to Azure Container Apps.

items.name: true-care
items.description: An AI-powered machine learning application designed to process healthcare reimbursement claims. It analyzes medical documents, client information, insurance policies, and legal regulations to predict accurate reimbursement amounts, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and fraud detection.

items.name: trusteval
items.description: Enterprise LLM Evaluation & Responsible AI Framework — Benchmark bias, hallucination, PII leakage, and toxicity across Healthcare, BFSI, Retail & Legal industries. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini & HuggingFace. Python SDK + CLI + Web Dashboard. 191 tests. Compliance-ready reports.

items.name: AIHospital
items.description: An LLM-powered multi-agent hospital simulation platform for clinical reasoning, role-based norm compliance, and interactive healthcare training.

items.name: dcm-anon
items.description: DICOM anonymizer (PS3.15 Basic Profile) with a verbatim-cited GDPR Art. 35 / HIPAA Safe Harbor / EU AI Act compliance manifest, independent PHI residual verifier, SHA-256 audit chain, and professional PDF report. MIT.

items.name: Medicore-Award-2026
items.description: Open-source healthcare interoperability platform built on FHIR R4, enabling legacy HIS modernization with enterprise-grade security (SSO/MFA), AI-powered scheduling, and TW Core IG compliance for Taiwan's healthcare ecosystem.

items.name: givecare-bench
items.description: AI safety benchmark for long-term caregiving relationships. Tests crisis detection, regulatory   compliance, and care quality across multi-turn conversations. Includes GiveCare system paper and InvisibleBench evaluation framework.

items.name: healthcare-ai-compliance-framework
items.description: Reference compliance-by-design framework documenting system architecture, decision governance, and auditability principles for AI-driven healthcare systems operating in regulated environments.
